best.idea: Amortize the load/writeback transition over multiple columns: try periodic templates with unequal gaps between load bursts, and use spare registers to extend selected operand lifetimes. Match each dot update to a slot and drain the stores as soon as their accumulators are ready.

attempts.idea: Assign a cyclic row-pair index to each lane and compute 17 distinct dot products per lane, in two register-resident tiles. Lay out inputs by row-pair bank and place symmetric outputs directly in the computing lane's bank.

Search for two small row sets whose even translations cover every unordered pair. Within each tile, stagger the loads onto alternate cycles and match MACs to periodic slots, allowing a few MACs to finish during the next column's loads.
